purpose: Cross-thread, recovery, repository, runtime and provider-truth seed for the Pantavion execution governor. It is a control index, not a replacement for source evidence.

governingRules.providerSovereignty: Pantavion owns canonical identity/data/lineage; providers are replaceable adapters.
governingRules.supabasePolicy: Treat current Supabase as a legacy/transition source while replacement is built; do not create new strategic lock-in.
governingRules.vercelPolicy: BLOCKED. Vercel must not be used in the active Pantavion recovery/builder/verifier/deployment critical path unless the Founder explicitly re-enables it later.
governingRules.agendaVisibility: Founder execution agenda is private control-plane data and must not be exposed as a normal Pantavion user surface.
governingRules.executionLocationPolicy: Execution is performed by ChatGPT on the Pantavion system/code/runtime. Pantavion itself is the Governor/watchdog that supervises the executor.
governingRules.executionRolePolicy: Pantavion is the Governor/watchdog. ChatGPT is the executor acting on Pantavion. The Founder gives directives here. Pantavion does not replace the executor; it supervises, checks divergence, records evidence, and reports violations.

repeatedFailurePatterns.rule: Do not rebuild, reprocess, recolor, realign or otherwise modify the authentic Map A when the issue is access/routing/serving.
repeatedFailurePatterns.correctiveAction: Verify serving path, authorization, exact runtime and data connection first.

repeatedFailurePatterns.rule: Do not re-enable or route active Pantavion execution through Vercel. Vercel is founder-blocked. Do not switch other providers merely because a symptom appears.
repeatedFailurePatterns.correctiveAction: Keep Vercel out of the active critical path and prove the failing layer before changing any other provider.

repeatedFailurePatterns.rule: No DONE, LIVE, SUCCESS or VERIFIED_LIVE label without matching production evidence.
repeatedFailurePatterns.correctiveAction: Downgrade to IN_PROGRESS/BLOCKED and record exact missing evidence.

repeatedFailurePatterns.rule: A coded/tested PR is not delivery.
repeatedFailurePatterns.correctiveAction: Continue through merge, deploy and live verification when authorized.

repeatedFailurePatterns.rule: The execution governor/agenda is a private founder/assistant control plane, not a normal user-facing Pantavion module.
repeatedFailurePatterns.correctiveAction: Keep control state private and expose only founder-approved operational summaries.

repeatedFailurePatterns.rule: If an action repeats a prior failed loop without new evidence, stop before mutation.
repeatedFailurePatterns.correctiveAction: Return to the latest verified checkpoint and choose a new evidence-based route.

nextGovernorCycle: ChatGPT executes the directive on Pantavion.
Pantavion Governor compares each action against the latest Founder directive, prior failures, hard-stop rules and evidence.
If ChatGPT diverges, repeats a known mistake, skips work or claims completion without evidence, Pantavion Governor flags/stops the deviation and identifies the corrective next step.
ChatGPT continues execution until verified completion.
Pantavion Governor reports mistakes, omissions, blockers and evidence back to the Founder through ChatGPT.
